answer: Let P be an attestation graph’s transition matrix; trust is the mass reaching identities in walks of at most k steps from independent anchors. A sybil cluster behind a sparse external cut has low conductance, limiting incoming walk flow and thus aggregate voting weight, provided anchor mass and per-edge influence are capped. Its endorsement plume cannot bootstrap trust across the bottleneck, unlike a well-connected meadow surrounding a mesa of honest attestations.
